title: Harmonic Number Series Associated with Certain Generating Functions
content: We present several series involving central binomial coefficients, Catalan numbers $C_n$, harmonic numbers $H_n$, odd harmonic numbers $O_n$, and certain products of these famous sequences. A highlight of our analysis is the derivation of closed-form expressions for the two classes $$\sum_{n=1}^\infty \binom {2n}{n} H_nO_n x^n\quad \text{and} \quad \sum_{n=1}^\infty C_nH_nO_nx^n.$$ Our results complement the findings of Lehmer, Boyadzhiev, Chen, and Li and Chu, among others. We will also derive new series involving products of harmonic numbers. Some of our series are nontrivial in the sense that the series cannot be expressed in terms of elementary functions but will involve combinations of dilogarithms. Only in exceptional cases, where the golden ratio is involved, can we express them in simple closed forms.
